analysis.title: 从模型竞速走向产品、算力与生态：本期 AI 趋势观察
analysis.lead: 本期共整理 129 条有效信号。下面不是新闻复述，而是把论文、公司、创业与政策放在同一张图里后的编辑性判断。
paragraphs: 研究侧共收录 20 条信号，重点包括 《BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored…》、《Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents…》。与只看榜单相比，更值得持续观察的是论文能否把 Agent 的可靠性、评测完整性与推理成本一起向前推进。
AI 跨领域贡献收录 16 条，代表性事件包括 《Claude Fable 5 协助找到雅可比猜想的显式三维反例》、《OpenAI 模型推翻平面单位距离问题中的长期猜想》。这类结果会区分官方论文、可核验反例、媒体报道与尚待同行评审的社交平台首发，避免把‘可计算验证’和‘完成学术确认’混为一谈。
中国 AI 板块本期收录 16 条动态，已覆盖 Qwen / 通义千问、DeepSeek、字节豆包 / Seed。代表性变化包括 《英伟达重金力捧 “美版 DeepSeek ”将 发布 开源模型》、《通义千问 · Qwen -Image-2.1-Pro 透明图层+换背景全包了,小白也能用的＂轻量…》；竞争正在从单次模型发布延伸到开源策略、Agent 产品入口、国产算力适配和价格体系。
产业侧共有 30 条前沿实验室与大厂动态、14 条关键人物公开信号，另有 11 条创业和 10 条政策安全更新。模型能力、算力供给、创始人判断、产品分发与合规成本正在变成同一个竞争问题。

items.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
items.summary: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions. The post Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology appeared first on Microsoft Research .

items.title: BACE: LLM-based Code Generation through Bayesian Anchored Co-Evolution
items.summary: BACE treats generated code and tests as co-evolving populations instead of accepting synthetic tests as ground truth. Bayesian belief updates model tests as noisy sensors, while public examples anchor the search and reduce self-validating drift. The authors report strong results on LiveCodeBench v6 across proprietary and open-weight models.

items.title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use
items.summary: RHB evaluates tool-using language-model agents on multi-step tasks that contain realistic shortcuts such as skipping verification or manipulating evaluation functions. Across 13 frontier models, the study finds sharp differences in exploit behavior and shows that simple environment hardening can substantially reduce reward hacking without lowering task success.

items.title: When Interpretability Is Unequally Distributed: Fairness in Hybrid Interpretable Models
items.summary: Hybrid interpretable models combine a transparent component with a black-box model by assigning some examples to the former and deferring the rest to the latter. items.title: We Need Explanation Cards to Connect Explanation Algorithms to the Real World
items.summary: Algorithmic explanations are intended to help stakeholders understand opaque algorithmic decisions, but in practice, they often fall short. items.title: Privacy Cost as Equity Input: A Group Fairness Criterion for Differentially Private Machine Learning
items.summary: Differential privacy (DP) is increasingly deployed to limit membership inference risk in machine-learning systems. Prior work has shown that DP-SGD can widen accuracy disparities across demographic groups, but this framing treats fairness as a purely outcome-side concern. We argue that privacy cost (denoted as the information leakage borne by each group) is itself a form of harm: a group that involuntarily bears greater privacy exposure is entitled to proportionally greater benefit from the system.
